section.title: Try It: Distributive Property

problem.para: Write down your answer, then select the solution button to compare your work.

solution.para: Here is how to simplify the expression using the distributive property:
Step 1 - Distribute the \(7y\) to both the \(4y\) and the \(\frac{3}{7}\) .

image.alt: DIAGRAM SHOWING 7Y TIMES 4Y MINUS THREE-SEVENTHS. AN ARROW IS GOING FROM 7Y TO 4Y. ANOTHER ARROW IS GOING FROM 7Y TO THREE-SEVENTHS.

solution.para:
Step 2 - Multiply the terms. Recall \(y \cdot y=y^2\).
\(7y(4y)-7y(\frac{3}{7})\)
